display.purpose: Hero title only; Archivo at 62% width, 800, uppercase.

headline.purpose: One per section; compressed heavy capitals.

statement.purpose: The About manifesto line, scroll-lit word by word.

body.purpose: Body copy at normal width, max 62ch.

label.purpose: Nav, buttons, form labels: Archivo at 125% width, uppercase.

motion.name: ease-out

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one interactive colour: Explore work, Hire me, Send enquiry.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #ff4fb8; color: #14051a; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 125%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff7ccc; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4fb8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions over the sky: Hire me in the hero, Live site and Source on projects.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(206,196,255,0.36); border-radius: 0; background: rgba(7,6,15,0.42); color: #f4f0ff; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 125%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #f4f0ff; background: rgba(7,6,15,0.7); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4fb8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, square stroke, magenta focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { color: #cdc6e8; font-stretch: 125%; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(206,196,255,0.36); border-radius: 0; background: #07060f; color: #f4f0ff; font-size: 16px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #a59dc9; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #ff4fb8; outline: 2px solid #ff4fb8; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Expanded capitals; the current chapter gets a magenta underline that scales in from the left.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; background: #07060f; padding: 20px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 10px 0; color: #cdc6e8; text-decoration: none; font-stretch: 125%; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 4px; height: 2px; background: #ff4fb8; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.is-active { color: #f4f0ff; } .ds-nav a.is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Chapter Title
components.description: Compressed heavy capitals, the page's title-card voice.
components.css: .ds-title { margin: 0; color: #f4f0ff; background: #07060f; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 62%; font-weight: 800; font-size: 64px; line-height: 0.88; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: The page is not a dark website with a hero image; it is one live sky (WebGL, src/world/) that the reader travels through. Each section is a chapter with its own time of day. The interface itself is quiet so the world can be loud: off-white type, hairline rules, square controls, and a single magenta signal for anything the visitor can act on.
keyCharacteristics: One procedural sky behind everything; colour lives at page scale in the world, not in UI accents.
One family (Archivo variable) at three widths: 62% titles, 100% reading, 125% labels.
Magenta is the only interactive colour; violet and blue belong to the sky and secondary titles.
All-sharp shapes (0px radius); the entity is the only round thing on the page.
Motion is authored per chapter: title-card wipes, a scroll-lit statement, uncovering rows, a sticky stack of stills, a route that draws itself.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Magenta means "you can act here". It never decorates a non-interactive surface except the accent line of a title card.

rules.name: The Sky Owns the Colour Rule
rules.body: Gradients, glows and saturated fields belong to the shader. UI elements stay flat: no gradient text, no glow borders, no coloured shadows.

rules.name: The Width Not Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy changes width and weight within Archivo. Never add a second display face or a serif for emphasis.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small label above a heading; the title card carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Border Or Nothing Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a hairline or nothing. Never a border plus a soft shadow.

dos: Do add new chapters to src/world/states.js when adding a section, so the sky changes with the reader.
Do use --ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)) for entrances and --ease-in-out (cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1)) for on-screen movement; keep UI transitions at or under 300ms.
Do gate hover effects behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and give every movement a reduced-motion variant that keeps opacity changes and drops transforms.
Do keep the entity's resting positions out of text columns.
donts: Don't put coloured glows, glass blur or gradient text on UI; the sky already carries the colour.
Don't round corners on controls or panels.
Don't add eyebrows or kickers above headings, or number the sections.
Don't use em dashes in visible copy.
